title: Sliding Lower Median
statement:
Maintain the lower median as values enter and expire. The lower median of k sorted values is at 1-based rank floor((k+1)/2).

Input
n k followed by n signed integers.

Output
Print one lower median for each length-k window in left-to-right order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ k ≤ n.
